name: Echo
author: parrotify
description: The bust and four ghosts of it that trail behind in its turn like a long exposure, turning against it on some beats, with a strobe on the beat and hard camera cuts. WebGL; the model needs Parrotify 0.0.9 or newer. Model: "Classical Healer Bust" by Sana Sato (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), simplified.
